item.slavicmyths.rune_stomp.desc: On landing after a fall of >=2.0 blocks, create a radius-3.5 knockback shockwave affecting hostile non-bosses; 20-second cooldown. No terrain destruction and no extra falling damage.
item.slavicmyths.rune_dispelling.desc: Negative magical-status duration -25%, rounded up to at least 1 tick. Every 45 seconds remove exactly one supported curable hostile magical debuff; exclude physical damage, hunger and critical story-control effects.
item.slavicmyths.rune_pursuit.desc: Three consecutive direct melee hits on the SAME living target within 4 seconds: third hit gets +15% final melee damage, then counter resets. Different target or >4s resets. One triggering hit per three.
item.slavicmyths.rune_suppression.desc: On successful melee hit, weaken this target next outgoing attack by 15% for up to 4s; per-target cooldown 25s. If timed during an interruptible cast wind-up, cancel that cast with explicit tag whitelist. Never silence all bosses globally.
item.slavicmyths.rune_battle_line.desc: When at least TWO eligible living allies stand within 10 blocks, the next incoming single heavy attack grants extra 15% damage reduction, then goes on 30s cooldown. Counts only players/tamed allied heroes with owner/team rules.
item.slavicmyths.gift_ilya_shield.desc: On fully-timed successful ACTIVE blocking of an eligible direct hit: emit radius-3 impulse, knock back nearby ordinary enemies, and deal EXACTLY 1.5 × the hypothetical mitigated HP damage of this same hit to its real attacker (after victim armor/resistance but before shield cancellation). Damage reflection on 35s cooldown; never chain reflect reflected damage.
item.slavicmyths.gift_dobrynya_ring.desc: After a valid active shield block, arm 4-second counterattack window. The NEXT direct melee hit deals 1.75× its otherwise-final damage (one amplified hit). 12-second cooldown after proc; expires without effect after 4s. Does not multiply reflected damage.
item.slavicmyths.gift_alyosha_belt.desc: Against a clearly telegraphed heavy direct hostile attack, attempt automatic 2.5-block sideways dodge to safe unobstructed spot, at most once/40s. If no safe location, do not move and do not spend cooldown. Never evade unavoidable arena-wide phases.
item.slavicmyths.gift_finist_amulet.desc: Every 4s scan hostile threats within 18 blocks; outline only selected entities briefly and give telegraph ping for heavy attack windup. No persistent xray of blocks or invisible ally reveal. 20-tick warning with precise direction.
item.slavicmyths.trophy_idol_chest.desc: On worn chestpiece: reduce attack knockback by 45%; reduce isolated heavy direct physical attack by 10%; apply movement speed -5%. No regeneration from eating or kills.
item.slavicmyths.trophy_marinka_cloak.de: As chest equipment: when damaged, blink 2–3 blocks to validated safe adjacent location, spawn smoke, 45s cooldown. Does NOT create illusion clones; fails without side effects when no safe slot.
item.slavicmyths.trophy_skim_necklace.de: While equipped, direct player damage to targets strictly below 30% max HP gains +10% after normal damage calculation. Boss eligibility allowed with no stacking beyond one necklace. Do not trigger on DoT/pets/reflection.
item.slavicmyths.trophy_kartaus_mantle.d: After killing a hostile boss-owned summoned mob (not friendly summons), gain Resistance I for 5 seconds, 20s cooldown. Only count documented summon ownership tags; never farm on your own allies.
item.slavicmyths.trophy_kalin_sabre.desc: Weapon base attack 9.0 and attack speed 1.3 (adjust to actual base API); each qualifying kill of ordinary hostile foe within 30s adds one Momentum up to 3. At 3, next deliberate fully-charged sweeping melee strike hits up to 3 additional non-allied foes in frontal 95° radius 4.5 at 60% hit damage. Consume 3 charges.
item.slavicmyths.mat_bone_plates.desc: Boss-exclusive crafting resource; no passive gameplay effect.
item.slavicmyths.mat_mirror_shards.desc: Boss-exclusive crafting resource; no passive gameplay effect.
item.slavicmyths.mat_skim_fang.desc: Boss-exclusive crafting resource; no passive gameplay effect.
item.slavicmyths.mat_banner_remnant.desc: Boss-exclusive crafting resource; no passive gameplay effect.
item.slavicmyths.mat_royal_iron.desc: Boss-exclusive crafting resource; no passive gameplay effect. Not a natural ore vein.
